FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 236
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/26/2026
Senate Bill 236 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an estimated $240 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 and ending in Fiscal Year
2029, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting Life on Wheels from paying
state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to county and municipal funds by the
following estimated annual amounts, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 and ending in Fiscal Year
2029, based on information provided by the entity, if the respective local governments adopt an
exemption from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this bill:
Fund Life On Wheels
County Funds $150
Municipal Funds $270
